summer_Wed: The moonlight jellies will be here soon. It's one of my favorite things about the valley.
ستصل قناديل ضوء القمر إلى هنا قريباً. إنها من أحب الأشياء إليّ في الوادي.
summer_Thu: The saloon gets pretty lively at night.#$e#I like to visit once a week or so to catch up on things. And to get a taste of Gus' authentic spaghetti.
تصبح الحانة حيويةً جداً ليلاً.#$e#أحب زيارتها مرةً في الأسبوع تقريباً لأطلع على المستجدات، ولأتذوق سباغيتي غاس الأصلية.
summer_Fri: Hmm... I wonder if it's anyone's birthday today? I'd better check the calendar by Pierre's shop.
همم... أتساءل إن كان اليوم عيد ميلاد أحد؟ من الأفضل أن أتفقد التقويم قرب متجر بيير.
summer_Sat: Everyone seems a little happier on the weekends, don't you think?#$e#I'm on the job seven days a week, though.

summer_Sun: Say, are you growing any blueberries on your farm?#$e#I do enjoy a fresh blueberry.%revealtaste:Lewis:258

fall_Mon: Some of the townsfolk are wary of strangers. You'll have to win their trust before they open up to you.#$e#Just be persistent and you'll get through to them.$h
يحذر بعض سكان البلدة من الغرباء. سيتعين عليك كسب ثقتهم قبل أن يفتحوا قلوبهم لك.#$e#ثابر فحسب وستصل إليهم.$h
fall_Tue: It was around this time of year when I first became Mayor, over twenty years ago.#$e#That makes me feel really old.$s
كان ذلك نحو هذا الوقت من العام عندما أصبحت عمدةً لأول مرة، منذ أكثر من عشرين عاماً.#$e#هذا يجعلني أشعر بأنني عجوز حقاً.$s
fall_Wed: If you have any suggestions for the town, just drop a note into my suggestion box.#$e#Oh, that's right... I don't have a suggestion box.
إن كانت لديك أي اقتراحات للبلدة، فضع ملاحظةً في صندوق اقتراحاتي فحسب.#$e#أوه، صحيح... ليس لدي صندوق اقتراحات.
fall_Wed2: Every Wednesday I have buckwheat waffles and coffee for breakfast. It's a little tradition I observe to keep the bachelor life interesting.$h
أتناول كل أربعاء فطائر وافل الحنطة السوداء والقهوة على الإفطار. إنه تقليد صغير أتبعه لإبقاء حياة العزوبية ممتعة.$h

fall_19: Sometimes you can tell if there's something buried underground. Just keep your eyes open.

fall_Fri4: Have you tried Gus' 'secret' spaghetti sauce?$s#$b#...The ingredients may be secret, but the smell isn't.#$b#I'll see you later.

fall_Sun: Are you doing your best on the farm, @? You'll have to accomplish things in many areas if you want to become a well-rounded citizen.

winter_1: Well, winter is here! That means the townspeople will be spending most of their days indoors.#$e#At least you'll know where to find them!$h

winter_Mon: Another year is almost over!#$e#I hope you had a productive year!

winter_Tue: I've got to start coming up with a plan for improving our town next year!
